svg.text: SOLDER SIDE — board flipped over sideways (left and right swap)
(soldered directly, no headers; solder ALL 38 pins)
Optional status LED (visible outside the box):
D1 LED: column 15, anode row 19, cathode row 20
solder bridge between the two pads
Link C LED cathode (15,20) → GND pin 26 (11,10)
bare wire: right to col 16, up to row 10,
Orange rings: the joints for the LED circuit.
This view is the board turned over:
column 1 is now on the RIGHT.
Power: USB 5 V charger into the devkit.
